title: gsmarena device slug index — BOTH halves (my box is still 429)
why: HIGHEST VALUE REMAINING. 873 of 1,323 devices have no chipset, which is the largest single gap on the board, and the chipset lane cannot adjudicate a device without one. My box is STILL rate-limited on gsmarena (verified HTTP 429 just now), so this is the one job only you can do. Both halves.
control: the Samsung brand page is fetched first and asserted to contain device links; if it does not, the run reports blocked rather than an empty index
expect:
RUN BOTH HALVES, SEQUENTIALLY, --delay 5.0:
  python3 relay.py run T004-gsmarena-slugs --force        # half 2
  python3 collect_gsm_slugs.py --out /tmp/gsm1 --half 1 --delay 5.0 --max-pages 60
About 30 min each. Pull first — the pager walks page NUMBERS now, not the first p<N> link it finds (that was re-fetching page 1 up to the cap), and the completeness oracle compares every brand against gsmarena's own declared device count. Below 95% on brands that HIT THE PAGE CAP the run refuses; brands that paginated to their natural end and are still short are a denominator difference (gsmarena's headline count includes tablets and watches the phones listing omits) and are reported separately.
A 429 now KEEPS the partial CSV instead of discarding it — resume rather than restart. Do NOT touch res.php3?sSearch=, it is Turnstile-gated.
